title: 樂天世界塔~Lotte World Tower
focus: 以核心筒、八根混凝土巨柱、外伸臂與 6.5 m 筏基組成的錐形超高層，並以延遲接合處理差異變形~A tapered supertall of core, eight concrete mega-columns, outriggers and a 6.5 m mat, using delayed connections to manage differential movement
summary: 樂天世界塔高 554.5 m、地上 123 層，以鋼筋混凝土核心筒與八根巨柱承擔重力與側力，兩道外伸臂與多道帶狀桁架把巨柱與核心筒綁在一起，並把頂部斜交網格燈籠與飯店柱轉換到巨柱上。基礎是 6.5 m 厚的筏基，斷層帶以不與筏基相連的補強樁改良地盤。本課沿著重力分擔、外伸臂、巨柱細長效應、帶狀桁架延遲鎖定、筏基一次澆置、預拱、監測與長期潛變，拆解這座韓國最高建築的工程邏輯。~Lotte World Tower is 554.5 m tall with 123 storeys above ground; a reinforced-concrete core and eight mega-columns carry gravity and lateral load, two outrigger levels and several belt trusses tie the columns to the core and transfer the diagrid lantern and hotel columns onto the mega-columns. It stands on a 6.5 m thick mat, with ground-reinforcing piles, not connected to the mat, improving fault zones. The course follows gravity sharing, outriggers, mega-column slenderness, delayed locking of belt trusses, a single-pour mat, camber, monitoring and long-term creep to unpack Korea's tallest building.

units.anchor: 核心筒與八根巨柱~Core and eight mega-columns
units.title: 核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔~Gravity sharing between core and mega-columns
units.mechanism: 公開資料指出核心筒承擔塔樓約 60% 的重力、八根巨柱約 40%。塔身由下而上收分，核心牆在中段三分之一向內傾斜，周邊柱在兩個方向上傾斜，因此重力不只產生垂直壓力，也在樓板與帶狀桁架處產生需要被平衡的水平分力。分擔比例取決於核心牆與巨柱的相對軸向勁度與施工順序，而不是單純依樓板面積的受載區域劃分；兩者應力水準若差太多，長期潛變就會造成明顯的差異縮短。~Public sources state that the core carries about 60% of the tower's gravity load and the eight mega-columns about 40%. The tower tapers with height, the core walls slope inward through the middle third and the perimeter columns slope in two directions, so gravity produces horizontal components that floors and belt trusses must balance as well as vertical compression. The split depends on the relative axial stiffness of walls and columns and on the construction sequence, not simply on tributary floor areas; if their stress levels differ greatly, long-term creep produces significant differential shortening.
units.model: 設底層總重力 G = 6.0×10⁶ kN：核心筒 0.6G = 3.6×10⁶ kN，八根巨柱共 2.4×10⁶ kN，每根約 300,000 kN。3.3 m×3.3 m 巨柱 A = 10.89 m²，平均壓應力 σ = 300,000/10.89 ≈ 27.5 MPa，約為 80 MPa 混凝土的 34%。數值為教學假設，忽略鋼筋與鋼骨貢獻。~Take a total ground-level gravity load G = 6.0×10⁶ kN: the core carries 0.6G = 3.6×10⁶ kN and the eight mega-columns 2.4×10⁶ kN, about 300,000 kN each. A 3.3 m×3.3 m mega-column has A = 10.89 m², so the average stress σ = 300,000/10.89 ≈ 27.5 MPa, about 34% of 80 MPa concrete. Values are teaching assumptions ignoring reinforcement and embedded steel.
units.verify: 以施工階段分析比較一次加載與逐層加載的核心筒／巨柱分擔比，確認兩者的長期應力差落在可控制的範圍；施工中於巨柱與核心牆埋設應變計，追蹤實測應力比是否與預測的 60/40 分擔一致。~Compare core/mega-column load sharing from one-step loading and from storey-by-storey construction-stage analysis, confirming that their long-term stress difference is controllable; during construction embed strain gauges in mega-columns and core walls to check that the measured stress ratio follows the predicted 60/40 split.
units.failure: 若巨柱應力遠高於核心牆，巨柱的彈性與潛變縮短會比核心筒大，周邊樓板逐年向外傾斜，連接兩者的樓板梁與外伸臂鎖入額外力量；反之核心筒縮短較多時，電梯與管道井的垂直度也會受影響。~If mega-column stresses are much higher than core-wall stresses, the columns shorten more elastically and by creep, perimeter floors tilt outward year by year and the beams and outriggers between them lock in extra forces; if the core shortens more, elevator and riser verticality suffers.
units.misconception: 核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔完全由樓板受載面積決定。~The gravity split between core and mega-columns is set purely by tributary floor areas.
units.practice: 設計初期就把核心牆與巨柱的長期應力差列為設計目標之一，必要時調整巨柱斷面或混凝土強度讓兩者應力相近，並在設計基準中寫明預期分擔比與監測驗證方式。~Treat the long-term stress difference between core walls and mega-columns as a design target from the outset, adjusting column size or concrete strength to bring stresses closer, and state the expected load split and its monitoring verification in the design basis.

units.anchor: 兩道外伸臂與帶狀桁架~Two outrigger levels and belt trusses
units.title: 外伸臂與帶狀桁架的側向作用~Lateral action of outriggers and belt trusses
units.mechanism: 外伸臂位於約 39–44 層與 72–76 層的機械避難層，帶狀桁架位於約 72–76 層與 104–107 層。當核心筒在風或地震下彎曲旋轉，外伸臂迫使一側巨柱受拉減壓、另一側受壓，形成反向力偶抵消部分核心彎矩，頂部變位與加速度隨之下降；帶狀桁架則把周邊柱串成整圈，使非直接連到外伸臂的柱也參與作用，同時把頂部燈籠與飯店層的柱轉換到巨柱上。~Outriggers sit at mechanical and refuge levels around floors 39–44 and 72–76, and belt trusses around floors 72–76 and 104–107. When the core bends and rotates under wind or earthquake, the outriggers force mega-columns on one side into tension relief and on the other into extra compression, creating a restoring couple that cancels part of the core moment and reduces top drift and acceleration; the belt trusses tie the perimeter into a ring so columns not directly attached to an outrigger also participate, while transferring the lantern and hotel columns onto the mega-columns.
units.model: 外伸臂恢復力矩 M_o = ΔP·d。若一側巨柱群產生 ΔP = 50,000 kN 的軸力變化、兩側力臂 d = 50 m，M_o = 50,000×50 = 2.5×10⁶ kN·m；若該高度以下核心筒承受的風彎矩為 1.0×10⁷ kN·m，外伸臂約抵消 25%。數值為教學假設。~The outrigger restoring moment is M_o = ΔP·d. If the mega-column group on one side changes axial force by ΔP = 50,000 kN with a lever arm d = 50 m between sides, M_o = 50,000×50 = 2.5×10⁶ kN·m; against a core wind moment of 1.0×10⁷ kN·m below that level, the outriggers relieve about 25%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在分析模型中逐一移除各外伸臂層，比較頂部變位、加速度與核心筒基座力矩，確認每道外伸臂的效益；並核對外伸臂斜桿與巨柱接頭在風、地震及長期差異縮短組合下的設計力。~Remove each outrigger level in turn in the analysis model and compare top drift, acceleration and core base moment to confirm each level's benefit; check the design forces in outrigger diagonals and mega-column connections under wind, earthquake and long-term differential shortening combinations.
units.failure: 外伸臂太剛時，巨柱與核心筒的差異縮短會在斜桿與接頭中鎖入巨大附加力，甚至超過風荷載本身；外伸臂太柔或位置不當，則無法有效降低變位，只增加機械層的鋼量與施工難度。~Outriggers that are too stiff lock large additional forces from differential shortening into diagonals and joints, sometimes exceeding the wind forces themselves; outriggers that are too flexible or poorly placed fail to reduce drift and only add steel and complexity to mechanical floors.
units.misconception: 外伸臂越多、越剛，結構表現就一定越好。~More and stiffer outriggers always make the structure perform better.
units.practice: 外伸臂層位置要與建築的機械、避難與空中大廳樓層共同決定，並在合約文件中規定外伸臂最終接合的時機與調整機制；每道外伸臂都應有可追溯的設計力來源說明。~Decide outrigger levels together with the mechanical, refuge and sky-lobby floors, specify in the contract documents when and how outriggers are finally connected, and document the source of every outrigger design force.

units.anchor: 3.3 m 巨柱細長效應~3.3 m mega-column slenderness
units.title: 巨柱尺寸遞減與細長效應~Mega-column step-downs and slenderness
units.mechanism: 巨柱由地面約 3.3 m 見方逐段縮小到約 1.4 m×2.3 m，核心牆與巨柱混凝土強度約 40 至 80 MPa。設計者指出底部巨柱在前八層沒有樓板側撐，屬細長構件：無側撐長度大時，軸力會放大柱身的初始彎矩與偏心，二階效應使彎矩比一階分析大得多。巨柱斷面逐段縮小時，偏心與勁度突變處也要特別檢核，避免應力集中與鋼筋續接過度擁擠。~The mega-columns step down from about 3.3 m square at ground to about 1.4 m×2.3 m higher up, and core and column concrete ranges from about 40 to 80 MPa. The designers note that the base mega-columns are unbraced by floors for the first eight levels and qualify as slender members: over a long unbraced length the axial load magnifies initial bending and eccentricity, so second-order moments are much larger than first-order analysis suggests. Where the section steps down, eccentricities and abrupt stiffness changes need specific checks to avoid stress concentrations and congested bar splices.
units.model: E_c = 4,700√80 ≈ 42,040 MPa，I_g = 3.3⁴/12 ≈ 9.88 m⁴，有效 EI = 0.4E_cI_g ≈ 1.66×10⁸ kN·m²。無側撐長度 40 m 時 P_c = π²EI/L² ≈ 1.03×10⁶ kN；設計軸力 P_u = 360,000 kN，彎矩放大 δ = 1/(1 − P_u/0.75P_c) = 1/(1 − 0.468) ≈ 1.88。若長度增為 48 m，δ ≈ 3.07。數值為教學假設。~E_c = 4,700√80 ≈ 42,040 MPa, I_g = 3.3⁴/12 ≈ 9.88 m⁴ and an effective EI = 0.4E_cI_g ≈ 1.66×10⁸ kN·m². For a 40 m unbraced length P_c = π²EI/L² ≈ 1.03×10⁶ kN; with a design axial load P_u = 360,000 kN the moment magnifier δ = 1/(1 − P_u/0.75P_c) = 1/(1 − 0.468) ≈ 1.88. At 48 m, δ ≈ 3.07. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以考慮幾何非線性、開裂與潛變的二階分析複核巨柱彎矩，並與規範的彎矩放大法比較；施工時量測巨柱垂直度與模板偏位，確認初始偏心不超過分析假設值。~Check mega-column moments with second-order analysis including geometric nonlinearity, cracking and creep, and compare with the code moment-magnifier method; during construction survey column plumbness and formwork offsets to confirm that initial eccentricity stays within the analysis assumption.
units.failure: 若忽略二階效應或低估施工偏位，巨柱在設計風或地震下的實際彎矩可能超出容量，柱身出現水平裂縫；斷面縮小處若續接鋼筋過密導致混凝土充填不良，也會形成弱點。~Ignoring second-order effects or underestimating construction offsets can let real mega-column moments under design wind or earthquake exceed capacity, cracking the shaft horizontally; overcrowded splices at step-downs that leave poorly compacted concrete also create weak spots.
units.misconception: 巨柱斷面巨大，所以不會有細長或挫屈問題。~A huge mega-column is too big to have slenderness or buckling issues.
units.practice: 無側撐高度大的巨柱應在施工計畫中訂定垂直度允差與量測頻率，並在澆置前檢查鋼筋續接區的淨距；斷面變化層的配筋詳圖須經結構工程師複核。~For mega-columns with tall unbraced heights, set plumbness tolerances and survey frequency in the construction plan and check clear spacing at splice zones before casting; reinforcement details at step-down floors must be reviewed by the structural engineer.

units.anchor: 帶狀桁架預埋板與長槽孔~Belt-truss embed plates and long slots
units.title: 帶狀桁架接頭與延遲鎖定~Belt-truss connections and delayed locking
units.mechanism: 帶狀桁架由預組段件在現場焊接到巨柱外側的預埋鋼板上，讓巨柱混凝土能連續施作而不被鋼構中斷。公開報導指出部分柱與帶狀桁架的接合採長槽孔，螺栓在塔樓完成後才鎖緊與重新定位；設計者也建議延後外伸臂最終接合，並設計長期力量轉移。長槽孔讓核心筒與巨柱在施工期的差異縮短自由發生，等主要重力就位後再鎖定，以減少鎖入的附加力。~Belt trusses are pre-assembled in sections and field-welded to embedded steel plates on the outside of the mega-columns, so the column concrete can be cast continuously without interruption by steelwork. Published reports say some column-to-belt-truss connections used long-slotted holes, with bolts tensioned and re-indexed after the tower was completed, and the designers recommended delaying the final outrigger connections and designing for long-term force transfer. The slots let differential shortening between core and columns occur freely during construction and are locked only after most gravity load is in place, reducing locked-in forces.
units.model: 長槽孔長度 ≈ 孔徑 + 2δ。M30 螺栓標準孔徑 33 mm，若鎖定前預期相對位移 δ = ±20 mm，槽長 = 33 + 2×20 = 73 mm，未超過 AISC 對 M30 長槽孔約 75 mm 的上限；若 δ = ±25 mm，需 83 mm，就必須改用其他可調細部。數值為教學假設。~Long-slot length ≈ hole diameter + 2δ. For an M30 bolt with a 33 mm standard hole and an expected movement of δ = ±20 mm before locking, the slot is 33 + 2×20 = 73 mm, within the AISC long-slot limit of about 75 mm for M30; for δ = ±25 mm it would need 83 mm, so another adjustable detail is required. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 鎖定前量測每個長槽孔內螺栓相對槽端的位置，確認尚有足夠的雙向餘裕；鎖定作業依預拉力規範抽驗，並以測量標高與應變紀錄證明鎖定時差異縮短已達預測比例。~Before locking, measure each bolt's position relative to the slot ends to confirm remaining travel in both directions; sample pretension during locking to the bolting specification, and use level surveys and strain records to show that the predicted proportion of differential shortening had occurred at the time of locking.
units.failure: 若螺栓在施工中途就被誤鎖或槽孔餘裕不足，差異縮短會讓螺栓頂住槽端並剪斷或使連接板挫屈；預埋板錨筋若設計不足，現場焊接與鎖入力也可能把預埋板從巨柱拉脫。~If bolts are tightened prematurely or the slots run out of travel, differential shortening drives bolts against slot ends, shearing them or buckling the plates; under-designed anchors behind embedded plates can let welding stresses and locked-in forces pull the plates out of the column.
units.misconception: 延遲接合只是施工方便，對結構受力沒有影響。~Delayed connection is only a construction convenience with no structural effect.
units.practice: 延遲接頭須在施工圖與現場以醒目標籤標示「暫不鎖定」，鎖定時機列為停留點，由結構工程師依監測資料確認後才可施作，並保存鎖定日期與預拉力紀錄。~Delayed joints should be tagged as do-not-lock on drawings and on site, with locking treated as a hold point released only after the structural engineer confirms the monitoring data, and the locking date and pretension records kept.

units.anchor: 6.5 m 筏基連續澆置~Continuous pour of the 6.5 m mat
units.title: 巨厚筏基的一次連續澆置~Single continuous pour of a massive mat
units.mechanism: 筏基約 72 m×72 m、厚 6.5 m，開挖深度約 38 m，承載塔樓約 75 萬公噸的垂直荷重，公開報導描述其以單次連續澆置完成。為避免冷縫與過高水化熱，採用 50 MPa 的低熱高流動性混凝土。單次澆置需要同時調度大量預拌車、泵車與布料點，使每一層新混凝土在下層初凝前覆蓋，讓整塊筏基成為無冷縫的整體；同時以溫度感測器控制內外溫差。~The mat is about 72 m×72 m and 6.5 m thick, at an excavation depth of about 38 m, carrying a vertical load of about 750,000 t, and was reported as placed in a single continuous pour. To avoid cold joints and excessive heat of hydration, a 50 MPa low-heat, high-flow concrete was used. A single pour demands simultaneous dispatch of many ready-mix trucks, pumps and placing points so each new layer covers the previous one before initial set, making the mat a monolith without cold joints, while temperature sensors control the interior-to-surface difference.
units.model: 澆置量 V = 31,200 m³、歷時 30 h，平均供料 1,040 m³/h；每層 0.5 m 覆蓋全面積需 72×72×0.5 = 2,592 m³，約 2.5 h 才回到同一點，初凝時間必須明顯大於 2.5 h。若 5,300 車次，平均每車約 5.9 m³，每小時約 177 車，即約每 20 s 一車。數值為教學假設。~A volume V = 31,200 m³ placed in 30 h means an average supply of 1,040 m³/h; covering the whole area in 0.5 m layers needs 72×72×0.5 = 2,592 m³ per layer, so placement returns to the same spot only after about 2.5 h and initial set must be well beyond 2.5 h. With 5,300 truckloads, each carries about 5.9 m³, about 177 trucks per hour or one every 20 s. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 澆置前做配比的絕熱溫升與凝結時間試驗、泵送試驗與交通演練；澆置中記錄每車出廠時間、坍流度與溫度，布料點依網格輪替並記錄層面覆蓋時間；之後以埋設感測器追蹤最高溫度與溫差直到降至允許值。~Before the pour, test adiabatic temperature rise and setting time, run pumping trials and rehearse traffic; during the pour record each truck's batch time, slump flow and temperature, rotate placing points on a grid and log layer coverage times; afterwards track peak temperature and differential with embedded sensors until they fall within limits.
units.failure: 若供料中斷或布料不均使某區層面暴露超過初凝，就形成冷縫，成為地下水滲漏與剪力傳遞的弱面；溫差控制失敗則會在筏基表面產生貫穿性溫度裂縫。~If supply is interrupted or placement is uneven so an area stays exposed past initial set, a cold joint forms that weakens shear transfer and admits groundwater; failed temperature control causes through-thickness thermal cracks at the mat surface.
units.misconception: 巨厚筏基只要混凝土強度夠，分多次澆置與一次澆置沒有差別。~If the concrete is strong enough, pouring a massive mat in one go or in stages makes no difference.
units.practice: 大體積澆置須有備援拌合廠、備用泵車與交通管制計畫，並預先規劃萬一中斷時的施工縫位置與處理方式；溫控計畫與停止條件須經結構工程師核准。~A mass pour needs backup batching plants, standby pumps and a traffic plan, with pre-planned emergency construction-joint locations and treatment in case of interruption; the thermal control plan and stop criteria require the structural engineer's approval.

units.anchor: 巨柱垂直預拱~Vertical camber of mega-columns
units.title: 差異沉陷的預拱補償~Camber compensation for differential settlement
units.mechanism: 核心筒與周邊巨柱的荷重與基底剛度不同，筏基在兩者之下的沉陷量也不同。設計者以在施工中對巨柱做垂直預拱（預先抬高）的方式處理核心筒與周邊之間的差異沉陷，使完工後樓板接近水平。預拱量來自地盤—筏基互制分析與施工順序，並在施工中依實測沉陷修正；若不預拱，周邊樓板會相對核心筒下傾，影響樓板排水、帷幕牆接縫與電梯門檻。~Because the core and perimeter mega-columns carry different loads and the mat stiffness beneath them differs, the mat settles differently under each. The designers handled differential settlement between the core and perimeter by vertically cambering, or pre-raising, the mega-columns during construction so floors end up close to level. The camber comes from soil–mat interaction analysis and the construction sequence and is updated with measured settlements; without it, perimeter floors would slope down relative to the core, affecting floor drainage, façade joints and elevator sills.
units.model: 若預測核心筒與巨柱間差異沉陷 15 mm、水平距離 20 m，角變量 = 15/20,000 = 1/1,333；對巨柱預抬 15 mm 後若殘餘誤差 ±5 mm，角變量降為 5/20,000 = 1/4,000。數值為教學假設。~If the predicted differential settlement between core and mega-column is 15 mm over 20 m, the angular distortion is 15/20,000 = 1/1,333; pre-raising the column by 15 mm with a residual error of ±5 mm reduces it to 5/20,000 = 1/4,000. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在筏基頂面與核心筒、巨柱腳設置沉陷觀測點，每增加若干樓層量測一次，與預測曲線比較並修正後續樓層的預拱值；完工後以全樓層標高測量確認樓板平整度。~Install settlement points on the mat top, core and mega-column bases, survey them after every few storeys, compare with the predicted curve and adjust camber for later floors; after completion confirm floor levelness with a full-height level survey.
units.failure: 預拱量若沿用設計預測而不依實測修正，實際沉陷較小時樓板會反向傾斜；預拱分配錯誤也可能讓帶狀桁架或外伸臂在鎖定時就承受非預期的初始力。~Applying design-stage camber without updating for measured settlement leaves floors sloping the other way if real settlement is smaller; misallocated camber can also load belt trusses or outriggers with unintended initial forces at the time of locking.
units.misconception: 筏基夠厚就會整體均勻沉陷，不需要考慮差異沉陷。~A thick enough mat settles uniformly, so differential settlement can be ignored.
units.practice: 預拱值應以表格逐層列出並標註版本，每次依監測更新時由結構工程師發布新版，測量團隊只依最新版放樣，避免多版本並存造成錯誤。~List camber values floor by floor in a versioned table; each monitoring-based update is issued by the structural engineer as a new revision, and surveyors set out only from the latest revision to avoid errors from coexisting versions.

units.anchor: 施工期自然頻率量測~Natural frequency during construction
units.title: 施工中頻率量測與模型校準~Frequency measurement and model calibration during construction
units.mechanism: 設計單位公開說明，結構健康監測系統在施工期間與完工後量測自然頻率，並與分析模型比較。施工中結構的質量與勁度隨樓層、帷幕牆與裝修不斷改變，因此每個階段的實測頻率都是校正模型的機會：若頻率比預測高，表示實際勁度較高或質量較低；若偏低，則可能是混凝土模數、開裂或非結構質量與假設不同。提早校準可以修正完工後的加速度預測與阻尼需求判斷。~The design team has stated that the structural health monitoring system measured natural frequencies during and after construction for comparison with analysis. Mass and stiffness change continually as floors, façade and fit-out are added, so each stage's measured frequency is a chance to calibrate the model: a higher frequency than predicted suggests higher stiffness or less mass, a lower one points to different concrete modulus, cracking or non-structural mass than assumed. Early calibration improves the prediction of in-service acceleration and of any damping need.
units.model: f = (1/2π)√(k/m)。勁度不變、質量因帷幕牆與裝修增加 25% 時，f₂/f₁ = 1/√1.25 ≈ 0.894；若結構體完成時實測 f₁ = 0.125 Hz，完工後預期約 0.112 Hz。若完工實測為 0.118 Hz，代表質量增量或勁度假設需要修正。數值為教學假設。~f = (1/2π)√(k/m). With unchanged stiffness and a 25% mass increase from façade and fit-out, f₂/f₁ = 1/√1.25 ≈ 0.894; a measured f₁ = 0.125 Hz at frame completion predicts about 0.112 Hz at handover. A measured 0.118 Hz would mean the mass increment or stiffness assumption needs correcting. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 於核心筒頂與數個中間樓層設置雙向加速度計，在低風時段做環境振動量測，以頻域分解辨識前三個模態；每次量測都記錄當時的樓層數、帷幕牆與裝修完成度，與同一施工狀態的模型比較。~Place biaxial accelerometers at the top of the core and several intermediate levels, take ambient measurements in calm periods and identify the first three modes by frequency-domain decomposition; record the number of floors and the extent of façade and fit-out at each measurement and compare with a model of the same construction state.
units.failure: 若只在完工後量一次頻率，與模型差異的原因無法分辨是勁度還是質量；以錯誤的模型推估加速度，可能低估居住性問題或高估需要的阻尼措施。~Measuring frequency only once after completion leaves it impossible to tell whether a mismatch comes from stiffness or mass; predicting acceleration from a wrong model can underestimate habitability problems or overestimate the damping needed.
units.misconception: 完工後量一次頻率，就足以校準整個結構模型。~A single frequency measurement after completion is enough to calibrate the whole structural model.
units.practice: 監測計畫要規定施工中量測的樓層節點與當時需同步記錄的施工狀態，並由結構顧問在每次量測後出具校準結論，作為後續預拱、加速度預測與交接基準。~The monitoring plan should define the construction milestones for measurement and the construction state to record alongside, with the structural consultant issuing a calibration conclusion after each measurement as the basis for camber, acceleration prediction and the handover baseline.

units.anchor: 斷層帶補強樁與筏基沉陷~Fault-zone reinforcing piles and mat settlement
units.title: 地盤補強樁與沉陷驗證~Ground-reinforcing piles and settlement verification
units.mechanism: 筏基主要坐落在岩盤上，設計容許承壓約 3,000 kPa；在斷層與剪裂帶，以衝擊旋轉鑽掘（PRD）施作直徑約 1.0 m 的補強樁改良地盤，官方資料稱共 108 根、長約 30 m。依當地法規，這些樁不與筏基相連，樁頂與筏基間以砂墊層隔開，所以它們提高的是地盤勁度，而不是當作傳統樁基礎直接承載柱力。設計以靜態與動態地盤彈簧模擬筏基，使不同區域的勁度差異反映在沉陷與筏基內力中。~The mat bears mainly on rock with an allowable bearing pressure of about 3,000 kPa; in fault and shear zones the ground was reinforced with piles about 1.0 m in diameter installed by percussion rotary drilling, reported officially as 108 piles about 30 m long. Under local regulations the piles are not connected to the mat and a sand cushion separates their tops from it, so they stiffen the ground rather than carry column loads directly as a conventional pile foundation. The mat was modelled on static and dynamic soil springs so stiffness differences between zones appear in settlement and mat forces.
units.model: 以地盤反力係數估算沉陷 s = q/k_s。接觸壓力 q = 1,400 kPa：岩盤區 k_s = 150 MN/m³ 時 s ≈ 9.3 mm；未補強的斷層帶 k_s = 50 MN/m³ 時 s = 28 mm，兩區相差約 19 mm。補強樁若把斷層帶 k_s 提高到 120 MN/m³，s ≈ 11.7 mm，差異降到約 2.3 mm。數值為教學假設。~Estimate settlement with a subgrade modulus, s = q/k_s. For a contact pressure q = 1,400 kPa, rock zones with k_s = 150 MN/m³ settle about 9.3 mm, while an unimproved fault zone with k_s = 50 MN/m³ settles 28 mm, about 19 mm more. If reinforcing piles raise the fault-zone k_s to 120 MN/m³, s ≈ 11.7 mm and the difference falls to about 2.3 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 補強樁施工後以鑽心或非破壞試驗確認樁身完整性，並以平鈑載重或孔內試驗量測改良後地盤勁度；筏基施工後在斷層帶與岩盤區分別設置沉陷點，比較實測差異沉陷與分析值。~After installing the reinforcing piles, confirm shaft integrity by coring or non-destructive testing and measure improved ground stiffness with plate-load or borehole tests; after the mat is cast, set settlement points over fault and rock zones and compare measured differential settlement with the analysis.
units.failure: 若斷層帶範圍調查不足，筏基某一角落的沉陷可能明顯大於預測，造成筏基彎矩重分配與上部結構差異變位；樁頂若未依設計與筏基隔開，樁會吸收集中荷載而在筏基內形成未預期的衝剪。~If the fault zone is poorly mapped, one corner of the mat can settle much more than predicted, redistributing mat moments and adding differential movement to the superstructure; if pile tops are not separated from the mat as designed, the piles attract concentrated loads and create unexpected punching shear in the mat.
units.misconception: 樁一定要與筏基連結才能發揮作用。~Piles only work if they are structurally connected to the mat.
units.practice: 補強樁與砂墊層的施工須列入檢驗停留點，包含樁頂高程、墊層厚度與壓實度；地質調查報告與實際開挖揭露的斷層位置要互相比對並由大地工程師簽認。~Make reinforcing piles and the sand cushion hold points covering pile-top level, cushion thickness and compaction, and have the geotechnical engineer reconcile and sign off the fault locations in the investigation report against those revealed by excavation.

units.anchor: 外伸臂長期力量轉移~Long-term outrigger force transfer
units.title: 潛變收縮與外伸臂的長期力量~Creep, shrinkage and long-term outrigger forces
units.mechanism: 外伸臂鎖定後，核心筒與巨柱之間仍持續發生潛變與收縮造成的差異縮短，這部分位移會被外伸臂桁架抵抗，轉成斜桿與接頭中的長期軸力，並把荷重在核心與巨柱間重新分配。設計者因此建議延後外伸臂最終接合，並針對長期力量轉移設計構件。鎖定越晚，鎖定後剩下的差異縮短越少，外伸臂承受的附加力也越小，但施工期間就得依靠其他系統提供側向勁度。~After outriggers are locked, creep and shrinkage keep producing differential shortening between core and mega-columns; the outrigger trusses resist that movement, turning it into long-term axial forces in diagonals and joints and redistributing load between core and columns. The designers therefore recommended delaying the final outrigger connections and designing members for long-term force transfer. The later the locking, the less differential shortening remains and the smaller the added force, but lateral stiffness during construction must then come from other systems.
units.model: 附加力 F = k·δ_post。外伸臂等效垂直勁度 k = 800 kN/mm：若鎖定後剩餘差異縮短 δ_post = 12 mm，F = 9,600 kN；若提早在結構只完成一半時鎖定，δ_post = 30 mm，F = 24,000 kN，增加 2.5 倍。數值為教學假設。~The added force is F = k·δ_post. With an equivalent vertical outrigger stiffness k = 800 kN/mm, a residual differential shortening after locking of δ_post = 12 mm gives F = 9,600 kN; locking early with only half the structure complete leaves δ_post = 30 mm and F = 24,000 kN, 2.5 times more. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以施工階段與時間相依分析預測不同鎖定時點的外伸臂力，選擇鎖定時點後在斜桿上設置應變計長期記錄，比對實測軸力增長與預測曲線，偏離過大時檢討潛變參數。~Use construction-stage, time-dependent analysis to predict outrigger forces for different locking times; after choosing one, install strain gauges on the diagonals for long-term recording, compare measured force growth with the prediction and revisit creep parameters if they diverge.
units.failure: 若沒有考慮長期力量轉移，外伸臂接頭可能在完工數年後因持續累積的軸力而出現螺栓滑移或焊道裂縫；核心筒牆體在外伸臂連接處也可能出現局部開裂。~Without allowing for long-term force transfer, outrigger joints may suffer bolt slip or weld cracking years after completion as axial force keeps accumulating, and core walls may crack locally at outrigger connections.
units.misconception: 外伸臂鎖定後，其中的力量就固定不再變化。~Once outriggers are locked, the forces in them no longer change.
units.practice: 交接文件應記錄外伸臂鎖定日期、當時的樓層與荷重狀態、預測長期力量曲線與監測基準，並規定定期比對；接頭應設計成可檢查，必要時可調整或補強。~Handover documents should record the outrigger locking date, the floors and load state at that time, the predicted long-term force curve and monitoring baseline, with periodic comparison required; joints should be inspectable and adjustable or strengthenable if needed.

units.anchor: 600 個感測器的健康監測~Health monitoring with 600 sensors
units.title: 結構健康監測與營運交接~Structural health monitoring and operational handover
units.mechanism: 官方資料指出塔內設有超過 600 個感測器的結構健康監測系統，即時監看颱風、地震與其他風險；設計論文提到量測項目包括風荷載、應力、位移、加速度、傾斜與現場反應，並以有限元素模擬輔助判讀。監測的價值在於建立基準：交接時的頻率、傾斜、應力與沉陷基準，讓事件後能以數據判斷結構是否仍在預期行為範圍內，並作為營運單位決定是否需要檢查或限制使用的依據。~Official sources say the tower has a structural health monitoring system of more than 600 sensors watching typhoon, earthquake and other risks in real time; the design paper lists wind loads, stresses, displacements, accelerations, tilt and field response, interpreted with finite-element simulation. Monitoring is valuable because it sets baselines: handover values of frequency, tilt, stress and settlement let engineers judge after an event whether the structure is still behaving as expected, and give the operator a basis for deciding whether to inspect or restrict use.
units.model: 基礎傾斜換算頂部變位 Δ = θ·H。若筏基傾斜計讀到 θ = 1×10⁻⁴ rad，對 H = 554.5 m 的塔，剛體轉動造成的頂部位移 Δ = 1×10⁻⁴×554,500 ≈ 55 mm。因此傾斜計的漂移或溫度效應若達 0.5×10⁻⁴ rad，就足以在頂部造成約 28 mm 的誤判。數值為教學假設。~Foundation tilt converts to top displacement as Δ = θ·H. A mat tiltmeter reading θ = 1×10⁻⁴ rad on an H = 554.5 m tower implies a rigid-body top displacement of Δ = 1×10⁻⁴×554,500 ≈ 55 mm. A tiltmeter drift or temperature effect of 0.5×10⁻⁴ rad would therefore misreport about 28 mm at the top. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 交接前完成感測器校正、溫度補償與資料品質檢查，並在低風時段建立頻率、傾斜與應變基準；訂定預警與行動門檻（例如頂部加速度、層間變位角與傾斜增量），每次事件後產出報告並與基準比較。~Before handover finish sensor calibration, temperature compensation and data-quality checks, and set baselines for frequency, tilt and strain during calm periods; define alert and action thresholds such as top acceleration, inter-storey drift ratio and tilt increments, and produce an event report compared with the baseline after every event.
units.failure: 感測器長期無人維護時，漂移、斷線與時間不同步會讓資料失去判讀價值；若門檻未事先定義，事件後各方對資料的解讀可能不一致，延誤是否疏散或檢查的決策。~Unmaintained sensors drift, lose connection and fall out of time sync until the data cannot be interpreted; without predefined thresholds, parties may read post-event data differently and delay decisions on evacuation or inspection.
units.misconception: 感測器越多，結構安全就越有保障，不需要人工判讀與維護。~More sensors automatically mean a safer structure without human interpretation or maintenance.
units.practice: 交接文件要包含感測器配置圖、校正紀錄、基準值、門檻與通報流程，並指定負責判讀的結構工程師與更換感測器的週期；營運單位每年檢討監測報告。~Handover documents must include the sensor layout, calibration records, baselines, thresholds and reporting procedure, naming the structural engineer responsible for interpretation and the sensor-replacement cycle; the operator reviews the monitoring report every year.

example: 設計練習：檢核筏基在重力加風力下的接觸壓力。塔樓垂直荷重約 75 萬公噸，W = 750,000×9.81 ≈ 7.36×10⁶ kN；筏基 72 m×72 m，A = 5,184 m²，平均接觸壓力 q = 7.36×10⁶/5,184 ≈ 1,419 kPa。設計風傾覆力矩取 M = 2.5×10⁷ kN·m，斷面模數 S = B³/6 = 72³/6 = 62,208 m³，壓力變化 ΔM/S ≈ 402 kPa，故 q_max ≈ 1,821 kPa、q_min ≈ 1,017 kPa，與容許承壓 3,000 kPa 相比利用率約 61%；偏心 e = M/W ≈ 3.4 m 小於 B/6 = 12 m，筏基全面受壓。若 M 加倍為 5.0×10⁷ kN·m，q_max ≈ 2,223 kPa、q_min ≈ 616 kPa，利用率約 74%，e ≈ 6.8 m 仍小於 12 m。荷重與筏基尺寸取自公開資料的約略值，風力矩與承壓判讀為教學假設，不代表實際設計。~Design exercise: check mat contact pressure under gravity plus wind. The tower's vertical load is about 750,000 t, so W = 750,000×9.81 ≈ 7.36×10⁶ kN; the mat is 72 m×72 m, A = 5,184 m², giving an average contact pressure q = 7.36×10⁶/5,184 ≈ 1,419 kPa. Take a design wind overturning moment M = 2.5×10⁷ kN·m; the section modulus is S = B³/6 = 72³/6 = 62,208 m³, so the pressure change is M/S ≈ 402 kPa, q_max ≈ 1,821 kPa and q_min ≈ 1,017 kPa, a utilisation of about 61% of the 3,000 kPa allowable; the eccentricity e = M/W ≈ 3.4 m is below B/6 = 12 m, so the whole mat stays in compression. If M doubles to 5.0×10⁷ kN·m, q_max ≈ 2,223 kPa and q_min ≈ 616 kPa, utilisation about 74%, and e ≈ 6.8 m is still below 12 m. Load and mat size are approximate public values; the wind moment and bearing interpretation are teaching assumptions, not the actual design.
history: 樂天集團自 1980 年代末就研究在首爾蠶室興建地標塔，先後考慮約十種其他方案後選定 Kohn Pedersen Fox 的錐形設計；Leslie E. Robertson Associates 擔任結構設計，Chang Minwoo Structural Consultants 為在地結構技師、Thornton Tomasetti 做同儕審查，樂天建設負責施工。2009 年開始方案設計，2011 年動工，2015 年 12 月結構封頂，2016 年 3 月頂部燈籠完成，2017 年 4 月開幕，成為韓國最高建築。工程上的特色在於以核心筒、巨柱、外伸臂與帶狀桁架組成系統，並用延遲接頭、巨柱預拱與長期力量設計處理差異變形。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Lotte Group studied a landmark tower at Jamsil in Seoul from the late 1980s and, after considering about ten other designs, chose the tapered design by Kohn Pedersen Fox; Leslie E. Robertson Associates was the design structural engineer, Chang Minwoo Structural Consultants the local engineer of record, Thornton Tomasetti the peer reviewer and Lotte Engineering & Construction the builder. Schematic design began in 2009, construction in 2011, the structure topped out in December 2015, the lantern was completed in March 2016 and the tower opened in April 2017 as Korea's tallest building. Its engineering signature is a system of core, mega-columns, outriggers and belt trusses, with delayed joints, mega-column camber and long-term force design to manage differential movement. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
